items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Britney’s a star, Elvis is a star?

ctx.x: Giants is cool. Yeah, I like that one. There are a lot of words you could use, but that comes from Hollywood. Hollywood is responsible for that star and stardom, and people believe that. “Oh, he’s a star, she’s a star, and Britney’s a star, Elvis is a star?” What did he do? Same thing that everybody else did, the same shit—excuse me—that everybody else did. He used drugs, womanizer—look at a star! (Laughs)
